1. The applicant vide the present application seeks interim bail for a period of two weeks in FIR No.0647/2022 dated 02.11.2022 registered under Sections 363/365/366/368/376/109 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 read with Sections 4/17 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 at PS.: Jaitpur, South East, Delhi.

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the father of the applicant expired on 05.11.2023 and that the applicant be granted interim bail to perform the last rites of his father which are to be held on 19.11.2023.
3. On the last date of hearing, notice was issued and Status Report, verifying the documents filed by the applicant qua the death of his father, was called for.

4. Learned APP for the State has handed over the Status Report stating that the factum of the demise of the father of the applicant has been This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 18/11/2023 at 01:12:09 verified from the concerned Police Station Pakridayal, East Champaran, Motihari, Bihar.
The Status Report is taken on record.

5. In view of the submissions made and considering the ground that the interim bail has been sought on the ground of the demise of the father of the applicant, this Court considers it a fit case to grant interim bail to the applicant.

6. Accordingly, the application is allowed and the applicant, accused in FIR No.0647/2022 dated 02.11.2022 registered under Sections 363/365/ 366/368/376/109 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 read with Sections 4/17 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 at PS.:

(i) The applicant shall not leave Village Chaita, PS. Pakridayal, East Champaran,
Bihar without prior permission of this Court and shall ordinarily reside at the address as per prison records.

sentences.text: (ii) The applicant shall present himself before the Local Police Station every alternate day between 11:00 am and 11:30 am to mark his presence.
However, he will not be kept waiting longer than an hour for this purpose.

(iii) The applicant shall furnish to the Investigating Officer/ S.H.O. P.S. Jaitpur a cell-phone number of any one family member on which the applicant may be contacted at any time and shall This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 18/11/2023 at 01:12:09 ensure that the number is kept active and switched-on at all times.

(iv) In addition to the above, the applicant shall share his real- time/live-location on Google Maps with the Investigating Officer and shall keep that setting 'on' at all times during the period of interim bail, so that the I.O. may be able to verify the applicant's location, at any time.
(v) If the applicant has a passport, he shall surrender the same to the concerned Jail Superintendent and shall in no case travel out of the country without prior permission of this court.
(vi) The applicant shall not contact, nor visit, nor offer any inducement, threat or promise to any of the prosecution witnesses or other persons acquainted with the facts of case.
The applicant shall not tamper with evidence nor otherwise indulge in any act or omission that is unlawful or that would prejudice the proceedings in the pending trial.

(vii) Upon expiry of the two weeks period of interim bail, the applicant shall surrender before the concerned Jail Superintendent by or before 04:00 PM on the date of expiry of two weeks from the date of release.
7.
A copy of the order be sent to the concerned Jail Superintendent for information and compliance forthwith.
8. The application is accordingly disposed of.
